page.overview:
What is Vitali?

Vitali was a Force power. the Sephi Tey Sirrek investigated the murder of the Sarravi V'Kara in the Shrine of Sarrav. Jedi Knight Vildar Mac, who had chased Tey after he witnessed him stealing from a Bpfasshi Truthsayer, spotted the Sephi standing next to the dead V'Kara and assumed Tey murdered her. The Kiffar Jedi attacked Tey with his lightsaber, but Tey managed to dodge the strikes. When Vildar angrily asked Tey how he was doing this, the Sephi claimed to have mastered many Force powers, including Vitali, the Cry of the Broken King and Morichro. Vildar dismissed that claim as nonsence, saying that Morichro is just a myth. Tey then used biological pheromones, his ancestors developed against predators, to temporarily knock out the Jedi, whilest claiming he was using the ancient rite of Morichro on Vildar.

Vitali was was mentioned in the first issue of the The High Republic (2022) comic run published by Marvel Comics as part of Phase II of Star Wars: The High Republic.
